name: gstack
description: Adapted gstack material: office hours, DESIGN.md consultation, divergent design variants, and the careful destructive-command guard.

skills.name: office-hours
skills.description: Use when asked to brainstorm, evaluate whether an idea is worth building, run office hours, or think through a new product idea or design direction before any code is written.

skills.name: design-system-doc
skills.description: Create or update DESIGN.md, the project's design-system file: product context, the one thing to remember, a token system (color, type, spacing, radius, motion) with a reason per choice, and a Decisions Log. Use for 'write a DESIGN.md', 'set up the design system', 'update DESIGN.md', 'record this decision', or when a picked direction should become the system.

skills.name: design-variants
skills.description: Explore several genuinely different directions for one screen, flow, state or asset before anything is built. Use for 'give me N directions', 'show me options', 'explore', 'mock up a few takes', 'what could X look like', 'show me alternatives'. Writes text concepts first and waits for confirmation before rendering HTML or image variants.

hooks.name: careful
hooks.description: Asks before destructive shell commands (recursive rm, DROP/TRUNCATE, force-push, git reset --hard, kubectl delete, ...) and denies rm -rf of / or ~ and force-push to the default branch. Best-effort string matching, not a security boundary.
